From: Tim Hayes <tim.hayes@aurorafin.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: security@aurorafin.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Key regime QA and snapshot request (SIG/CAIQ items)

Hi Jasmine,

AuroraFin is working through the SIG and CAIQ sections related to encryption and key management as part of our onboarding sprint. The SOC team has a few asks where we need sample artifacts from the last 90 days to validate operational practices and rotation controls. Can you provide the following (redacted where necessary):

- Recent key rotation timeline for KEKs/DEKs (last 90 days) including scheduled vs. executed times and responsible operator IDs
- Signed HSM shift/hand-off logs (sample of 3 distinct shifts) and operator separation attestations
- CSEK/CSEK-wrapping telemetry showing usage counts per tenant (CSV preferred)
- Evidence of in-transit encryption for key movement (TLS versions and cipher suites used, and any envelope-wrapping references)
- Emergency rekey playbook (procedural steps) and a short narrative of the last emergency rekey (if any)

Delivery method: we prefer SFTP with a short-lived account, or a pre-authorised Drive folder. Please indicate if you will scrub tenant IDs and how you intend to redact PII.

Timeline: we are hoping to get a first tranche by next Wednesday (2026-05-27) to meet our internal audit window.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Tim Hayes
Security Program Manager
AuroraFin

--
This request maps to CAIQ: Encryption In Transit / At Rest and SIG: Key Management sections.

Hi Tim — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. High-level plan below:

What we'll provide (sampled and scrubbed):
- Rotation timeline CSV (executed vs scheduled) with aggregated operator IDs (we'll map to ephemeral operator numbers, not personal emails)
- Three signed HSM shift logs (redacted operator emails, include shift hashes and timestamps)
- CSEK usage telemetry (CSV) with tenant identifiers hashed; we will include a mapping seed statement so Aurora can verify hashing approach
- TLS/cipher-suite inventory for key transport endpoints (last 90 days) and envelope wrapping references
- Emergency rekey runbook (PDF) and a short redacted narrative of the last event

Questions for you:
1) Preferred transfer: SFTP or Google Drive? If SFTP, please provide an upload path and a short-lived username/key.
2) HSM attestation format — do you prefer the device attestation as a PEM or a signed PDF export?

We plan to produce the bundle and upload by EOD 2026-05-27 assuming we get your transfer preference today. CC'ing Marissa (operations) and Ben (crypto assurance) to own the artifact collection. Naomi will help with PII redaction.

Regards,

Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Key regime QA and snapshot request (SIG/CAIQ items)

Tim / Jasmine — quick clarifications from the crypto team before we package: 

- HSM attestation: we can export the vendor attestation in both PEM and signed PDF. If Aurora requires the cert chain for verification, let us know and we'll include the chain.
- Shift logs: logs will be zipped (kms-rotation-sample-logs-90d.zip). Each log file will include a SHA256 header for integrity and an operator ID that is an internal operator number (not PII).
- Telemetry: csek-usage-telemetry-90d.csv will include per-tenant encrypted key-use counters; tenant IDs will be hashed using a seeded SHA256 approach. We'll include the seed statement and a short verification script (readme) so Aurora can confirm transforms offline.
- In-transit proof: we will include a TLS inventory and tcpdump-level header samples (redacted), and a short note about our envelope wrapping flow referencing the KEK->DEK wrapping schema.

We will not include customer plaintext data. All artifacts intended for audit will be redacted and accompanied by a small integrity manifest (file list + SHA256).

If SFTP, please provide the hostname and a path. If Drive, please confirm the folder and add security@aurorafin.com.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Crypto Assurance Lead
Redwood Inference
